name: Hiizumi Kaede
source:
"Kaede Hiizumi here. I'm the mastermind behind the site Ogre.com. Oh, but that's a secret, okay? The wise hawk--and merchant--hides her talons!"

She founded the global shopping website Ogre.com. A young business prodigy, she primarily works overseas to keep operations running smoothly. Her real name is a secret, and few know her true identity.

However, the character Clea Glaive from World's Odyssey shares an eerily similar background. It surprised Kaede herself when she played the game. Although she wasn't involved in the development of the game, don't you find it strange that a character just like her appears in it?

How did [url=/c160573]Shiina[/url], the game's writer, get her personal information? Well, maybe the God of Death already has a guess.

At first, she's skeptical of the Iris Corp. crew, but after a major incident at a department store, she becomes a reliable ally. [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] will have to fight with everything she's got during the incident...

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category5&ch=kaede]official website[/url]]
